answer: Proof-of-personhood attestations reward each epoch only when a wallet stakes an independent bond into a per-epoch summit contract, and that bond is slashed if any two wallets resolve to one operator. To amplify with fake identities a cartel must post a full bond per duplicate, and every duplicate risks forfeiting all at once. The cost of N clones thus scales linearly with N while the payout stays flat, so cloning loses money. A public lotus seal and a periodic mirror of prior answers make retroactive edit of the roster detectable, so an attacker cannot repair a forged history after the fact.
